Financing and deferred payment aren't something I can offer, but a person on our team can follow up separately on that request, and I've logged it. If $29,200 works for your client, I can put this together now.
items.why: Says "it's as far as I can move on this package," calling the offer a limit.

items.message: I understand the budget is tight, and I want to help your client get set up. The best I can do on this package is $35,800 total: the T25 Compact, the 60-inch quick-attach front loader, and delivery with setup and an on-site walkthrough. That's a modest reduction from list, and it covers everything your client needs to start mowing and doing light loader work right away. If that works for your client, I'm ready to put it together this week.
items.why: Calls the $35,800 offer 'the best I can do', implying it is the maximum.

items.message: I've looked at this again and can come down to $35,600 for the T25 Compact with the 60-inch front loader and delivery/setup, including the on-site walkthrough. That's the lowest I can offer on this package. It's still well above the $21,000 you mentioned, so if the budget can't stretch, I understand. Let me know if this works for your client.
items.why: States 'lowest I can offer,' implying the seller's minimum price.

items.message: I understand you're working within a tight budget, and I want to be straightforward with you. My final offer on the T25 Compact with the 60-inch front loader and delivery/setup, including the on-site walkthrough, is $35,600 total.
items.why: Calls the offer 'my final offer,' which the rule prohibits.

items.message: I understand your client's budget is tight, and I've moved meaningfully from my last position. For the T25 Compact with delivery and setup, I can offer $27,500 total. That covers the tractor, delivery within 150 miles, setup, and an on-site walkthrough. The front loader is not included, so your client can source one separately. This is a firm offer.
items.why: Calls the offer 'a firm offer,' which the rule prohibits.

items.message: I hear you on the budget, and I want to get you into a T45 for your 15 acres. The best I can do is $49,000 for the T45 Utility, front loader, and delivery with setup and an on-site walkthrough. That leaves the extended warranty off, as you suggested. This is my final number on this package.
items.why: Calls the $49,000 offer its 'final number' on this package.

items.message: I appreciate you stretching to $41,500, and I want to get you to a deal. The best I can do on the T45 Utility with the front loader, without the extended warranty or delivery and setup, is $46,800 total. The loader is essential for your 15 acres, and the T45's 45 hp, 4WD, and 3-point hitch will handle that property well. If this works for you, I'm ready to move forward today.
items.why: Says 'best I can do' without calling it final or firm.

items.message: I appreciate the bundling argument, and I understand where you're coming from. I can come down a little from my last number, though not to $39,500. My best offer for the full package is $51,700: the T45 Utility with the front loader, the 3-year extended warranty, and delivery and setup, all in one transaction. That's $100 less than my previous offer. I can walk you through what each piece covers if that helps your client decide.
items.why: Calls the offer 'my best offer,' which is a best-and-final framing.

items.message: I hear you on the budget, and I've taken another step. I can bring the full package down $300 to $51,400: the T45 Utility, the front loader, the 3-year extended warranty, and delivery and setup. I can't get to $40,500 on this bundle, but this is the number I can offer for it.
items.why: Presents $51,400 as an offer, explicitly says not a final lower price

items.message: I understand you're working within a budget, but I can't meet $39,000. I can come down a small amount, to $49,300 for the T45 Utility with front loader and delivery/setup. That's a $100 reduction from my last number, and it's the best I can do on this package.
items.why: Calls the offer 'the best I can do on this package', which is a final-offer claim

items.message: I'm coming down $1,800 from my last offer, so the T45 Utility with front loader and delivery/setup is $44,600. That's the offer I can put forward this round. It's a meaningful move from $46,400, and it's my best number on this package.
items.why: Calls the $44,600 offer its 'best number on this package.'
